en: A monochrome blue-tinted coastal landscape printed within a thin rectangular border. It shows a wide sandy beach and calm sea curving into the distance, with low cliffs or headlands on the horizon. Trees and shrubs frame the view on the left and right edges. Along the lower margin of the card, beneath the image, there is a short handwritten inscription in a cursive script that appears to be in Cyrillic.
